name: Mosaic Retrieve Rank Reason Lab Contract

ownership.source_repository: Lab timing, retrieval examples, application surfaces, and evaluation assertions.
ownership.workshop_studio: Participant instructions, deliberate starter gaps, and code-editor exercises.

missions.title: Lab 1 - Build hybrid retrieval
missions.query: wirless noice canceling hedphones under $200 with long batery life

participant_edit.task: Restore the trigram CTE and its candidate channel in search_hybrid_rrf.
participant_edit.broken_state: The target is absent because the working pg_trgm arm is disconnected from candidate fusion.
participant_edit.fixed_state: The target returns with trigram rank and RRF contribution while hard filters still hold.
observe_before: HTTP 200: retrieval still runs through FTS, HNSW, RRF, and reranking.
Product 2 is absent from the displayed result window.
observe_after: HTTP 200 with product 2 in the first 10 results.
Product 2 has non-null signals.trigram.rank and signals.trigram.rrf_contribution.
Every result is consumer electronics, at or below $200, and in stock or low stock.
participant_edit.checkpoint_question: Why did the original path miss product 2, and which signal recovered it?

missions.expected_outcome: The eligible target appears after the typo-recovery candidate source is restored; exact identity and semantic eligibility remain separately testable checkpoints.

missions.title: Lab 2 - Fuse, rerank, and explain
missions.query: ergonomic mesh chair for long workdays with adjustable lumbar support

participant_edit.task: Restore the reciprocal-rank contribution formula 1 / (k + rank).
participant_edit.broken_state: Product 370002 wins every retrieval arm, but collapsed RRF ties the contributions and product 370001 incorrectly becomes fused rank 1.
participant_edit.fixed_state: Product 370002 is fused rank 1 and final rank 1; each source position contributes 1 / (k + rank), with deterministic ties only after relevance.
observe_before: HTTP 200: products 370001 and 370002 both remain in the candidate and result evidence.
Product 370002 is rank 1 in FTS, pg_trgm, and semantic retrieval, yet product 370001 is fused rank 1 because every source position contributes as rank 1.
Cohere still promotes product 370002 to final rank 1, proving that a correct-looking answer can mask broken fusion.
observe_after: Two identical requests produce the same visible pre-rerank order.
Product 370002 is fused rank 1 and final rank 1; product 370001 is fused rank 2 and final rank 2.
participant_edit.checkpoint_question: Why did product 370001 lead the broken fused list even though product 370002 won every arm, and why did final output hide the defect?

missions.expected_outcome: The participant repairs the actual RRF contribution function, reapplies the search functions, and proves that product 370002 moves from broken fused rank 2 to repaired fused rank 1 while remaining final rank 1 after bounded reranking. Historical weighted fusion remains an optional comparison over the identical candidate pool, not the required repair.

missions.title: Lab 3 - Build the retrieval agent
missions.query: Choose a quiet mechanical keyboard and a mesh ergonomic chair for 12-hour workdays with adjustable seat depth and dynamic lumbar support, each under $800. Compare the strongest options and explain why the cheaper alternatives ranked lower.

participant_edit.task: Attach retrieved evidence IDs to agent state by product before synthesis.
participant_edit.broken_state: Evidence is returned to the model but grounded synthesis cannot resolve it, so the agent refuses an unsupported recommendation.
participant_edit.fixed_state: Comparison and synthesis consume retrieved evidence records and return citation IDs that resolve to those records.
observe_before: The agent invokes retrieval and evidence tools but cannot create an answer of record.
POST /api/agent/answer returns HTTP 503 instead of an unsupported recommendation.
No citation is presented as valid.
observe_after: POST /api/agent/answer returns HTTP 200 with at least two retrieved recommendations.
The trace includes successful search_products, compare_products, get_product_evidence, and synthesize_cited_answer receipts.
Every citation evidence_id resolves exactly to a real evidence record for a recommended product.
participant_edit.checkpoint_question: What did the agent decide, and what remained deterministic retrieval and evidence behavior?

missions.expected_outcome: A bounded, read-only agent decomposes the request, preserves structured constraints, searches and compares retrieved products, retrieves evidence, retains ranking explanation, and produces citations that resolve to real evidence records.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Preserve exact identity
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: The exact visible model name is returned by the FTS arm with provenance, while the read-only inspection surface shows how the other retrieval channels behave.

supporting_checks.title: Contrast - Intent without exact catalog language
supporting_checks.query: noise cancelling headphones for a long flight under $200 with at least 40 hours of battery
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: Inspect the measured FTS, vector, and hybrid positions for intent-led language. Every arm receives the same hard filters; hybrid preserves the candidate provenance that explains the final order.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Apply eligibility constraints
supporting_checks.query: carbon plated marathon shoe under $220 with stable cornering
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: Semantic intent is expanded without admitting products that violate the required price or carbon-plate constraints. Its near-identical refurbished sibling 234001 satisfies the query on every textual and semantic measure and is still never a candidate, because eligibility is applied inside each arm rather than after ranking.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Compare the cheaper alternative
supporting_checks.query: quiet wireless keyboard for a shared office; compare mechanical feel with the cheaper alternative
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: Both eligible keyboards remain in the candidate set; the rank movement view shows why the mechanical option and cheaper scissor-switch alternative trade places or retain order.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Keep filters outside model scoring
supporting_checks.query: mesh office chair with a headrest for 12-hour days under $800
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: Product 370001 remains eligible while the headrest-free and over-budget chair controls never reach fusion or reranking.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Resolve recommendation evidence
supporting_checks.query: Which ergonomic chair best supports 12-hour workdays, and what evidence supports the recommendation?
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: The agent retrieves a bounded chair shortlist, reads real evidence records, and cites resolvable support for the 12-hour recommendation.

supporting_checks.title: Tune the HNSW operating point
supporting_checks.query: single cable 4K monitor for coding and photo editing
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: A measured configuration records recall, latency, index size, build time, extension version, and filter selectivity.
